title: Otori Emu — A Sweet, Sweet Memory〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright... Let the chocolate fondue party begin!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you both for coming even though you're so busy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, don't worry about that!
Everyone needs a break once in a while, and I was really happy to get your invitation!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But Saki, why did you wanna have chocolate fondue?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I had this treat a long time ago where they coated strawberries in chocolate, and it was super yummy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So I thought, if it's that good with hardened chocolate, it'd probably be even better coated in melty chocolate fondue!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Gotcha!
And then you totally wanted to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We bought plenty of strawberries, so let's eat a whole lot today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, let's get right down to the prep.
We can split up the tasks like making the chocolate sauce and cutting our dippers, so let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Ms. Airi!
What should we do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Emu, you can chop these chocolate bars into small pieces, and Saki, can you slice the fruit? I'll get the hot water bath and the milk ready!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The chocolate sauce is all done♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I finished slicing everything and getting it all lined up♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good work, you two!
Now we just pour our chocolate sauce into this fondue machine, and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, it's a melty, glistening, chocolatey fountain...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh! How about we start by eating together on three?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
Okay, I'm gonna capture the moment in a photo♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, dip it in the chocolate slowly so it doesn't splash, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Wh-Whoa, it's dripping, it's dripping!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, look, look!
The chocolate's all smooth and shiny☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It looks super cute, and I bet it's just as yummy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, looks like we're all ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then let's eat! One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mm-mmm!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The inside of my mouth feels so wonderhoy with the sweeeet strawberries and the warm melty chocolate!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel like I could just keep eating this forever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is bliss...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We ate most of the standard dippers...
How about we get you-know-what started?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's time for “Curveball Competition: Which is the tastiest?”

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, it's fun how this kinda feels like one of MMJ's streams♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's true.
Then first, can I ask that we all share what curveballs we brought?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for me, I brought sweet potatoes and tomatoes! They're vegetables, but I think they'll go well with chocolate since they're sweet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I brought rice crackers and almonds!
I figure the sweet and salty will be the ultimate combination!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I brought fish sausages and little snack cheeses! I had a bunch at my place!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Fish?!
These foods... This will probably make for some juicy shots.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's get to trying them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ooh... Rice crackers, you never fail to impress!
They go great with the chocolate, and it's fun how they go crunchy crunch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Mhm!
I could keep eating these forever...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know... But these are probably insanely high in calories. This is some terrifying food...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our next contestant is...the mini tomatoes! Emu, Airi, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mmm... Mmm?!
Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know the feeling...
For a second you think it might be good, but in the end it's pretty iffy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see, last up is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The fish sausages!
This whole time I've been wondering how it'll taste!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was kinda avoiding it, but now it's time to face it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-This is actually good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The sausage is a bit salty, so it makes the chocolate taste sweeter... This really stimulates the appetite!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Amazing, Emu!
This is a huge discovery that needs to get passed down to future generations!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm really glad I had you at home, fish sausages!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think I'll have one more...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want another too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh... Then, what if we put a fish sausage and some cheese on a skewer and ate them together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That's a great idea...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, are you a genius...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've come this far, so let's keep going and find out what goes best with the fish sausage too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
